[[File:Piretti - Lumi aritmetici, 1725 - 4646851.tif |thumb|upright|''Lumi aritmetici'', 1725]]

'''Ferdinando Piretti''' (17th century – 18th century) was an Italian [[mathematician]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://thesaurus.cerl.org/cgi-bin/record.pl?rid=cnp00125635|title= Piretti Ferdinando in CERL Thesaurus}}</ref> He lived at the San Vitale monastery in [[Ravenna]] and later at the San Benedetto monastery in [[Ferrara]].
